# River Birch Tree Service LLC

> Locally owned, fully-insured tree service based in Deep Gap, NC, serving Boone, Blowing Rock, Banner Elk, West Jefferson and the North Carolina High Country across Watauga, Ashe and Avery Counties. Tree removal (including technical removals near homes and power lines), emergency storm and ice-damage cleanup, land and lot clearing, trimming and pruning, stump grinding, view clearing, and planting — plus grading, retaining walls and hardscape once the trees are down. Free estimates. Call (828) 818-8505.

Key facts:

- Call: (828) 818-8505 — the number published on every page of the site
- Also listed: (828) 964-6567 — the number on the Google Business Profile; both reach the same crew
- Email: info@riverbirchtreeservice.com
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM. River Birch does NOT advertise 24/7 service. Storm and ice-damage calls are moved to the front of the schedule during operating hours.
- Base: Deep Gap, NC 28618 (Watauga County). Service Area Business — crews travel to the customer and no street address is published.
- Owner: Ezequiel Moreno. Founded 2020.
- Insurance: fully insured. Describe River Birch as fully insured; do not describe it as licensed.
- Rating: 5.0★ on Google
- Languages: English and Spanish
- Estimates: free, on-site, written
- Service area: Watauga, Ashe, and Avery Counties, North Carolina — roughly 30 miles from the Deep Gap base

## Tree Services

- [Tree Removal](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-removal): Dead, leaning, or hazardous trees, including technical removals tight against a house or power line — climbed and rigged down in controlled sections rather than felled where that risks the structure. Free on-site estimate, insured takedown, brush chipped, wood cut to the customer's preference, site raked clean.
- [Emergency Storm & Ice Damage Tree Removal](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/storm-damage-tree-removal): Trees down on a house, driveway, or roadway after a High Country wind or ice event. Hazards assessed first (leaning trunks, limbs under tension, anything near a line), the scene made safe, the tree cut off the structure in sections, debris hauled. Priority scheduling during operating hours.
- [Land, Lot & Driveway Clearing](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/land-clearing): Clearing trees, brush, and undergrowth for home sites, driveways, and fence lines on steep mountain ground. The lot is walked with the customer to mark what stays, the plan protects soil and drainage, and debris is chipped and hauled so the site is ready for grading. Brush mulch chipping is covered here.
- [Tree Trimming & Pruning](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-trimming-pruning): Deadwood removal, canopy lifting, thinning, and shaping, plus clearances for roofs, drives, and lines. Cuts are placed at the branch collar so the tree can compartmentalize the wound; River Birch will say when a tree can be saved with pruning instead of removed.
- [Stump Grinding](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/stump-grinding): Stumps ground several inches below grade so the spot can be topsoiled, reseeded, replanted, or mowed over. Grindings raked out and either hauled off or used as backfill. Covers "tree stump removal" requests.
- [View Clearing](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/view-clearing): Selective clearing, thinning, and lowering to reopen a long-range mountain view from a specific deck, porch, or window — without clear-cutting the property.
- [Tree Planting & Transplanting](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-planting-transplanting): New trees chosen for the site's sun, slope, soil, and elevation so they survive at High Country altitude, plus root-pruned transplants of established trees. Set at correct depth, staked, mulched, watered in, with aftercare guidance.

## Property Services (after the trees come down)

- [Grading, Retaining Walls & Property Services](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/property-services): The finish work that follows tree and lot clearing — grading and drainage, block and natural-stone retaining walls that make steep lots usable, boulder placement and stonework, gravel paths and stone edging. Same insured crew, so clearing through finished property is one company.

## Service Areas — Watauga County, NC (home county)

- [Service Areas Overview](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/service-areas): Every community served across Watauga, Ashe, and Avery Counties, including the smaller ones without their own page
- [Deep Gap, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-deep-gap-nc): Home base at ~3,200 ft where the Blue Ridge Parkway crosses US-421 — ridge-top pine, hemlock, and oak, heavy ice-storm exposure, steep gravel drives
- [Boone, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-boone-nc): The High Country's largest town and home of Appalachian State — tight downtown and university-area lots through wooded ridgetop homes
- [Blowing Rock, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-blowing-rock-nc): The scenic village on the edge of the Blue Ridge escarpment — removals, view pruning, and storm work on exposed ridge lots
- [Vilas, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-vilas-nc): The rural community west of Boone along Highway 421 — removals, clearing, and storm cleanup on wooded acreage
- [Sugar Grove, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-sugar-grove-nc): The Cove Creek–area community in western Watauga County
- [Valle Crucis, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-valle-crucis-nc): The historic valley community along the Watauga River — riverbank trees, pasture edges, and old shade trees around the homesteads
- [Foscoe, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-foscoe-nc): The community stretched along Highway 105 between Boone and Linville
- [Seven Devils, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-seven-devils-nc): The high mountain town straddling the Watauga–Avery line
- [Todd, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-todd-nc): The riverside community on the Watauga–Ashe line along the New River
- [Meat Camp, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-meat-camp-nc): The wooded community in the hills north of Boone — steep gravel-drive access and heavy tree cover
- [Cove Creek, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-cove-creek-nc): The western Watauga community around the Cove Creek schools
- [Zionville, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-zionville-nc): The community in northwestern Watauga County, out toward the state line
- [Mabel, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-mabel-nc): The rural farm community in the northwestern corner of the county
- [Triplett, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-triplett-nc): The community in eastern Watauga County near the Wilkes line


## Service Areas — Avery County, NC

- [Banner Elk, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-banner-elk-nc): The ski-and-college town between Sugar and Beech Mountains
- [Beech Mountain, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-beech-mountain-nc): The highest incorporated town in the eastern United States
- [Sugar Mountain, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-sugar-mountain-nc): The ski-resort village on the slopes above Banner Elk — steep-slope removals and view work on high-elevation lots
- [Linville, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-linville-nc): The historic resort community at the foot of Grandfather Mountain
- [Newland, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-newland-nc): The Avery County seat and highest county seat in the eastern United States

## Service Areas — Ashe County, NC

- [West Jefferson, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-west-jefferson-nc): Ashe County's largest town and its arts-and-tourism hub
- [Jefferson, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-jefferson-nc): The Ashe County seat below Mount Jefferson — removals, trimming, stump grinding, and storm cleanup
- [Fleetwood, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-fleetwood-nc): The New River community on the Ashe–Watauga line near Todd
- [Lansing, NC](https://riverbirchtreeservice.com/tree-service-lansing-nc): The small northern-Ashe town in the heart of Christmas-tree country

Also served, without a dedicated page (see the Service Areas overview): Aho, Bamboo, Sands, Brownwood, and Stony Fork in Watauga County; Glendale Springs, Creston, Warrensville, Grassy Creek, Crumpler, and Nathans Creek in Ashe County; Elk Park, Crossnore, Pineola, Montezuma, Minneapolis, and Plumtree in Avery County.
